_comment: wayfarer load journeys -- DATA consumed by the target-agnostic k6 engine under tests/load/ (schema documented in tests/load/lib/config.js). Group names become the k6 `route` tag and per-route threshold keys. budgetMs values are milliseconds.

static._comment: prerendered routes: cheap, safe against the public deployment

results._comment: server-rendered, needs the data backend. Excluded from the smoke set on purpose: while the backend is paused every /results shape returns 500 (blocker_a3ba1690), and load traffic must not hammer an erroring route on the public deployment.
